provenance.statement: Equivalent engineering model of L3 replacement behaviour, self-calibrated from on-device measurements. Not a reverse engineering of, nor a claim about, any specific vendor microarchitecture (tag RAM / way-select / replacement bits).

documented_model.source: Intel Open Source PRM TGL Vol.7 Memory Cache (public; software implementations permitted; no document derivatives)

retention_knee.note: measured knee is a cross-check; the reuse trend is partly measurement amortisation (more passes hide the first-pass miss), not a power law

empirical_fit_cross_check.model: knee(reuse) = c0_bytes * reuse^alpha   (NOT used as the model)
